## v0.3.1: 2026-09-30

gridappsd-go is a Go client library for GridAPPS-D / GOSS. This patch release
tightens how the token exchange reports a failed teardown of its credential
connection. It changes no exported API.

### What changed

- fix: a teardown step failure after the token exchange had already failed is
  logged with `token_received=false` also when the context ends during the
  teardown, where it was dropped before. The exchange still fails with its own
  error (#31).
- fix: the credential connection is closed after a teardown step fails while
  the context is live, instead of being left to the transport (#31).
- fix: the text a teardown error reports through `Error()` is cut to 512 bytes
  plus its full length, so a broker ERROR message of any size no longer
  reaches a log that prints that text. A handler that unwraps the error still
  reaches the full message (#31).
- fix: an UNSUBSCRIBE and a DISCONNECT failure are joined with `; ` rather
  than a newline (#31).
- fix: the 512-byte bound applies to each of the UNSUBSCRIBE and DISCONNECT
  errors before they are joined, so a long UNSUBSCRIBE message no longer hides
  the DISCONNECT error (#34).
- fix: ASCII control characters in a teardown error, line breaks and terminal
  escapes among them, are written as `\xNN` escapes, so a broker message
  cannot split a log line (#34).

### Known issues (unfixed)

- go-stomp can still keep a goroutine past the close of the credential
  connection, since no public API on this module can close or drain the
  underlying connection (#24).
- Test coverage of both control-byte checks in the teardown error escape, and
  keeping an escape sequence whole where the text is cut at 512 bytes, remain
  open (#36).

### Merged pull requests

- #33: teardown reporting in the token exchange (#31)
- #35: bound each teardown step error and escape control characters (#34)

### Migration notes

- Database: no migration, this is a library with no persistence.
- Breaking changes: none. The changes are inside the module's internal
  packages and no exported identifier is added, changed or removed.

### Deployment

- Module: `github.com/GRIDAPPSD/gridappsd-go@v0.3.1`
- No container image: this is a Go library, not a deployable service.
